finite_plateau_claim: For every constant-deviation interval 3<=r<=s, writing T=a_r and V=a_s, V<Q<=2*T^2*(T-1)^2<2*T^4, where Q is the least 2*4^k above T^2*(T-1)^2/2.
source_comparison: Strengthens the coefficient displayed in Tang arXiv:2603.09939v2 Theorem 1.4; the plateau strategy and threshold-function iteration are credited to Tang.
explicit_nonclaims: No upper bound on the deviation
No density-one or linear upper-bound theorem
No global novelty or priority certificate
independent_checks: Normal, -O, -OO give identical mathematical reports; separately implemented bitset and sliding-window greedy generators agree for 4000 terms; complete through-value-200000 hash agrees with candidate.
integrity_controls: Ten negative mutations rejected in each of normal, -O, -OO; original candidate unmodified.
resolved_reproducibility_issue: Candidate assertion-based verifier now rejects optimized Python rather than silently skipping assertions. Independent audit checks use optimization-safe explicit guards.
publication_boundary: Authored proof audit and public-source verification metadata only; no copied third-party source documents or imported dataset contents.
